notes:
Trigger fieldset in **State or time** mode (CHR-1146; trigger `{text, actor?, via?, state?, at?}`). Sample case `renew-automatically`.

Fields: Description (text), **When all of these hold** — condition rows `role="group"`: Subject (native select), Property (mono), Operator (native select with words: is, is not, less than, at most, greater than, at least, is one of → `eq ne lt lte gt gte in`), Value (mono), remove. **At** (optional date or date-time, mono; shown as "from …" on the trigger line). **No Actor field**: actor and via belong to the Action mode; a trigger with an actor plus state/at is a shape error (§3.8/§6). Switching modes keeps the text and clears the other mode's fields. Hint: "No actor here: the world starts this case, not a persona."

**Value parse rule** (state and condition values): `true` / `false` → boolean; a plain number (`17`, `0.15`, `-3`) → number; everything else → string, a date stays a string (`2027-01-01`); quotes force a string (`"17"`). "is one of" takes a comma-separated list (`student, apprentice`), each item parsed the same way; an empty list is an error.

**Errors (block Save, decision chr1103):** "is one of" without a list → Value `chrome-field mono-error`, "Add at least one value, separated by commas."; malformed **At** → `mono-error`, "Use a date (2027-01-01) or a date and time (2027-01-01T09:00)."; footer names the first error, Save disabled. Pattern as `usecases-edit-dialog-branch-invalid`.

A grey box documents the operator words and the symbols the detail uses; a "Trigger line in the detail" preview shows the result with `uc-condition-chip` and its `time` variant. Conditions are documentation: artisign checks subjects (`unknown_participant`, target `/trigger/state:<subject>.<property>`), never values.

Flows: "Action" → `usecases-edit-dialog-world`; close / Cancel / Save → `usecases-detail-world`.
